name: Libido Aventure -S Rank Boukensha dakedo, Ponkotsu Succubus dake no Party de Kyoukan Shitemasu-
original_name: リビドー・アバンちゅ～る -Sランク冒険者だけど、ポンコツサキュバスだけのパーティで教官してます-
source:
[b]They Get Stronger Every Time They Drain You! Retrain Five Hopeless Succubus Girls Through… SEX!? [/b]

You want me to retrain FIVE utterly hopeless succubus girls!?
The name’s Glenn Magna. I’m an S-rank adventurer who’s cleared countless high-difficulty quests—and to put it bluntly, I’m a man who’s been through a lot. Time and time again, I’ve been saddled with impossible quests under the lame excuse that "You’re the only one who can do it!" After years of being everyone’s errand boy, I finally hit my limit.

[b]"Isn’t there an easier way to make a living...!?" [/b]

That’s when inspiration struck. Instead of being the one doing the grunt work... 
[b]"Why not become an instructor and raise a party strong enough to do it for me?" [/b]
While continuing my career as an adventurer, I started working as a guild instructor. But one day, the Guild Master handed me the most ridiculous request yet.

[b]"Please... just do something about those girls!" [/b]

The party he assigned to me consisted entirely of succubi—and they were a complete disaster. Terrible with swords. Hopeless with magic. They’re so incompetent they’ve never even managed to clear a beginner-level quest. They’re the most spectacularly useless party of succubi anyone has ever seen.

But succubi possess one unique racial trait. By using their [i]“Semen Absorption”[/i] ability, they can absorb [i]highly concentrated life essence[/i] through naughty acts, dramatically boosting their individual power.
And, by an incredible stroke of luck... (or terrible luck?) I just so happen to possess an incredibly rare body overflowing with the highest possible concentration of life essence.

[b]"Instructor Glenn's... semen... it's incredible...!"
"To think... it can become our strength...!" [/b]

Train them through SEX. Fight through SEX. Deepen their bonds through SEX.
Can this hopeless band of succubi grow into a legendary adventuring party?
The goal is simple: [i]Raise an elite team capable of handling dangerous jobs on their own! [/i]
Until then, the legendary adventurer's hardships are far from over...

translation:
[b]每次他们耗尽你的精力时，他们就会变得更强！通过……性重新训练五个绝望的魅魔女孩！？[/b]你想让我重新训练五个彻底绝望的魅魔女孩！？
我的名字叫格伦·麦格纳。我是一个完成了无数高难度任务的S级冒险者——说实话，我是一个经历过很多事情的人。一次又一次，我以“你是唯一能做到的人！”为借口，背负着不可能完成的任务。经过多年充当每个人的跑腿后，我终于达到了自己的极限。

[b]“就没有更简单的谋生方法吗……！？” [/b]就在那时，灵感袭来。而不是做那些繁琐的工作…… 
[b]“为什么不成为一名教练并组建一支足够强大的队伍来为我做这件事呢？” [/b]在继续冒险者生涯的同时，我开始担任公会指导员。但有一天，会长向我提出了迄今为止最荒谬的要求。

[b]“拜托……为那些女孩做点什么吧！” [/b]他分配给我的队伍完全由魅魔组成——他们完全是一场灾难。用剑就可怕了对魔法毫无希望。他们太无能了，甚至连初级任务都没有完成。他们是人们见过的最无用的魅魔队伍。

但魅魔拥有一种独特的种族特征。通过使用[i]“精液吸收”[/i]能力，他们可以通过顽皮的行为吸收[i]高浓缩生命精华[/i]，从而大幅提升个人实力。
而且，由于令人难以置信的运气……（或者可怕的运气？）我恰好拥有一个极其罕见的身体，充满了最高浓度的生命本质。

[b]“格伦教官的……精液……太不可思议了……！”
“思考……可以成为我们的力量……！” [/b]通过性来训练他们。通过性来战斗。通过性加深他们的联系。
这支绝望的魅魔乐队能否成长为一支传奇的冒险队伍？
目标很简单：[i]培养一支能够独立处理危险工作的精英团队！[/i]到那时，这位传奇冒险家的艰辛还远未结束……
